notes.title: Hurl Flames At Your Opponents With Our New Terrain Object
notes.content:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/D0g1xW21/patch-announce-2021-02-03.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0g1xW21/patch-announce-2021-02-03.gif[/img][/url]

A small number of updates with big implications!
[list]
[*]New terrain object - "Flame Trigger"
[*]Bug fixes / stability improvements
[/list]

[h2]New Terrain Object - "Flame Trigger"[/h2]
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/Lsck5KCg/content-feature-2021-02-03.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Lsck5KCg/content-feature-2021-02-03.gif[/img][/url]

Ever grow impatient waiting for a terrain object to come into play?

Well here's an idea–Our newest object Flame Trigger is like a cannon that shoots when you tell it to. There's a big visible button on the battlefield, and when you move your character on it, it hurls flames at your opponents over an entire column. One should never play with fire, except when it means big damage to your opponents!

notes.title: New Prototype Character In Our Latest Build!
notes.content:
[https://i.postimg.cc/YSvh7tV9/patch-announce-2020-09-16.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/YSvh7tV9/patch-announce-2020-09-16.gif[/img][/url]

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*][b]New prototype character - Character 8[/b]
[*]UI improvements
[*]Bug fixes / stability improvements
[/list] 
Yes, we have new playable character! Character 8 really shakes up the roster by offering new, unique ways of dealing damage. Try them out, and let us know your thoughts!

[h2]New Prototype Character - Character 8[/h2]

[https://i.postimg.cc/5tDjNZdm/content-feature-2020-09-16.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5tDjNZdm/content-feature-2020-09-16.gif[/img][/url]

Character 8 is good at punishing fast, trigger-friendly enemies. Equipped with abilities that inflict Shock—whenever the affected character deals damage, they incur elemental damage themself—they can make fast opponents think twice before launching an all-out attack. Their stance "Ramping Strike" is also in line with this concept, having the ability to crush those who like to rapidly inflict damage.

In our opinion, Character 8 is a strong counter to the Ranger and Totem. We want to know your thoughts on this so please try them out!

notes.title: We Revamped the Berserker and Warrior!
notes.content:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/NGJsWvMS/patch-announce-2020-08-19.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/NGJsWvMS/patch-announce-2020-08-19.png[/img][/url]

Steamhounds version 0.4.8 "Pendulum" is here!
[list]
[*]Berserker abilities overhaul
[*]Warrior tweaks including a new ability
[*]New battle music
[*]Bug fixes / stability improvements
[/list] 
We really wanted to revisit some of our original characters and make them better. Through our community, we gained tremendous insight over the course of many tournaments, and we observed the gaps and spaces where our characters can shine even brighter.

And we are definitely listening to your suggestions! Someone suggested new music. So we added a brand new battle theme! Hope you like it.

[h2]Reworked Berserker Abilities[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/WbdNVYq3/berserker-revamped.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/WbdNVYq3/berserker-revamped.png[/img][/url]

In the latest patch, the Berserker has gone through some major changes, but its core concept remains the same – a slow heavy-hitter whose desire to kill gives them tunnel vision and can make them reckless at times. Our new set of abilities really drives this home while making them even more dynamic and fun, overall.

So try out them out yourself, and tell us what you think!

[h2]Tournament Announcement[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/VkMzrSRP/stream-announce-2020-08-22.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/VkMzrSRP/stream-announce-2020-08-22.png[/img][/url]

We are hosting yet another Steamhounds tournament this upcoming Saturday (August 22th) 6:00pm UTC / 2:00pm ET. Prizes will include a [b]custom in-game avatar[/b] and Steam gift cards!

To take part, [url=https://discord.com/invite/StrayBasilisk]visit our Discord[/url], and drop us a message in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/359472400188047360/496695365664374791]#tournament-chat[/url] channel. Remember to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://www.twitch.tv/straybasilisk]tune in to our Twitch channel[/url] as we stream a live coverage of the tournament and talk about the updates in the new patch. See you there!

notes.title: Terrain Effects New In Our Latest Patch!
notes.content:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/fLK9Qhs2/patch-announce-2020-07-22.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLK9Qhs2/patch-announce-2020-07-22.gif[/img][/url]

Steamhounds version 0.4.6 has landed! What’s new you ask?
[list]
[*][b]New Feature – Terrain Effects[/b]
[*]UI improvements
[/list] 
Terrain Effects has been on our radar for some time, and we are excited to finally share them with you! We believe they add another layer of strategy that supports our core gameplay – we are looking forward to hearing your thoughts!

[h2]Terrain Effects[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/bv1nLtBj/content-feature-2020-07-22.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/bv1nLtBj/content-feature-2020-07-22.gif[/img][/url]

Terrain Effects are effects positioned on a tile that trigger when a character steps on them. Beneficial in some situations, and harmful in others, they can quickly turn the tide of battle if used correctly.

In our first wave of available terrain effects (more to come), we have two effects that you’ll encounter in your battles. Half Cover is defensive, mitigating incoming ranged attacks by halving their damage. Corrosion is a harmful effect that causes Poison – at the start of the character’s turn, they’ll take 5 damage.

We feel that terrain effects are an interesting addition to grid layouts. We can already see new strategies developing where positioning becomes an even more important factor in every battle. We can’t wait to see you try them out!

[h2]Tournament Announcement[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/fLZ9PRGS/stream-announce-2020-07-25.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLZ9PRGS/stream-announce-2020-07-25.png[/img][/url]

We are hosting yet another Steamhounds tournament this upcoming Saturday (July 25th) 6:00pm UTC / 2:00pm ET. Prizes will include a [b]custom in-game avatar[/b] and Steam gift cards!

To take part, [url=https://discord.com/invite/StrayBasilisk]visit our Discord[/url], and drop us a message in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/359472400188047360/496695365664374791]#tournament-chat[/url] channel. Remember to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://www.twitch.tv/straybasilisk]tune in to our Twitch channel[/url] as we stream a live coverage of the tournament and talk about the updates in the new patch. See you there!

notes.title: A new patch, and another new prototype character!
notes.content:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/ZnTgdDDM/patch-announce-2020-06-24.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZnTgdDDM/patch-announce-2020-06-24.gif[/img][/url]

Steamhounds version 0.4.4 “Mantel” has arrived! Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]New character prototype – Character 7[/b]
[*]Ability and balance tweaks
[*]Bug fixes / stability improvements
[/list]   

Main news is that a new character prototype has landed (details can be found further below)! We are excited to have players try them out – let us know your thoughts!

[h2]New Character Prototype – Character 7[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/pdFgbjFq/content-feature-2020-06-24.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pdFgbjFq/content-feature-2020-06-24.gif[/img][/url]

Character 7 is like the Warrior in that they perform the role of a tank. Their main stance “Sweeping Guard” is an alternate take on the Warrior’s Guard where they can guard not only the tile behind them but also to their sides, providing cover to more than one ally simultaneously. But that’s not all. They can also dish out solid damage with row based attacks which can be effective in breaking up enemies formations along rows.

While you may think they are overpowered, they have a major weakness. They are vulnerable to a stackable status effect called “Fatigue” which reduces both their physical and elemental defense by 1. They can gain Fatigue by performing certain skills or stances, and without paying close attention, their Fatigue can quickly pile up, making them susceptible to heavy damage.

This is a prototype character! There’s much to be tweaked. We are really looking forward to everyone’s feedback – please take them for a test drive, and let us know what you think!

[h2]Tournament Announcement[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/5yKJgFT1/stream-announce-2020-06-27.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5yKJgFT1/stream-announce-2020-06-27.png[/img][/url]

It's tournament time! Again, there are prizes up for grabs (such as Steam giftcards) so make sure to sign up by [url=https://discord.com/invite/StrayBasilisk]visiting our Discord[/url], and dropping a message  in [url=https://discord.com/channels/359472400188047360/496695365664374791]#tournament-chat[/url]. notes.title: Steamhounds New Patch Release v0.4.2 "Lighthouse"
notes.content:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/NFZwYCmk/patch-announce-2020-05-27.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/NFZwYCmk/patch-announce-2020-05-27.gif[/img][/url]

Steamhounds version 0.4.2 “Lighthouse” has released today! Here are the changes:

    New feature: [b]Alternate Battlefield Layouts[/b]
    Ability and balance tweaks
    Minor bug fixes / performance improvements

Yes, we now have the ability to tweak our battlefield for different layouts! This means that the battlefield is not only restricted to a 3×3 grid, but can have rows or columns blocked off, or even have specific tiles be inaccessible. We are currently experimenting with different layouts so please help us find the most interesting ones!

[h2]New Feature: Alternate Battlefield Layouts[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/4dNG19XV/content-feature-2020-05-27.gif][img]https://i.postimg.cc/4dNG19XV/content-feature-2020-05-27.gif[/img][/url]

With the introduction of alternate battlefield layouts, certain characters may have an advantage when fighting on certain grid patterns. Take, for example, the Berserker where they may be well suited in a stage that restricts movement to only two rows – this narrows down the number of rows that can be targeted with Tunnel Vision, making that stance easier to pull off.

With this in mind, the battlefield layout for each battle will be shown while players are in the character selection screen so that characters can be chosen accordingly.

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/jSPRqT8w/layout-2.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/jSPRqT8w/layout-2.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/15L9ZXK1/layout1.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/15L9ZXK1/layout1.png[/img][/url]

In addition to our normal layout, we currently have two alternate layouts in the game which are chosen at random when a match is created. As you may see above, the layouts basically block off a single row or column. We felt that we should start simple before it evolves into something more complicated. Please try these out yourself, and help us discover what other interesting patterns we can put in the game!

And to let you know, these new layouts will be implemented for our upcoming tournament so be ready!

[h2]Tournament Announcement[/h2]

[url=https://i.postimg.cc/FzYQMXdK/stream-announce-2020-05-30.png][img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzYQMXdK/stream-announce-2020-05-30.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Steamhounds New Patch Release v0.4.0 "Automaton"
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3JzpF0V9/patch-announce-2020-04-29.gif[/img]

We just dropped the first big patch in a while for our game, Steamhounds! Here's a breakdown of the updates:
[list]
[*]New character prototype - "Character 6"
[*]Ability and balance tweaks
[*]Bug fixes / performance improvements
[/list]
The main update here is the introduction of a new character: Prototype 6 (name not permanent =P). This is part of the team’s effort to start dropping new content every few weeks for players to try out. So be on the lookout for more content in the weeks to come...

[h2]New Character Prototype: Character 6[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/1XnX8JmS/content-feature-2020-04-29.gif[/img]

The new charcter's main tactic revolves around a skill called “Place Totem”, which drops an object onto an enemy tile. This object can then be manipulated to deal damage and inflict debuffs on nearby targets.

One major bonus to this skill is that the object will block enemies from occupying the tile that it’s placed on. We're interested to see what players will do with this, and how it'll affect positioning in play, or be used to disrupt enemy formations. We'd also love to hear any feedback people have about the concept!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/LX0h4rMv/feedback-corner.png[/img]

[h2]Tournament Announcement[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/XqRJddqC/stream-announce-2020-05-02.png[/img]

We're also trying something else new - running regular developer streams and tournaments! We'd love to have people take part, and we also have a bunch of prizes (like Steam credit) lined up.
